item.rollercart.switch_ties.desc: Pushes carts off to the right when powered
item.rollercart.detector_ties.desc: Outputs a redstone signal of varying strength when a cart passes
item.rollercart.track.desc: Links two Track Ties blocks together
item.rollercart.track.chain.desc: Pulls minecarts along the track, can be powered by redstone to accelerate
item.rollercart.track.station.desc: A combination of a brake track and a chain drive track
item.rollercart.track.brake.desc: Slows carts down if not powered
item.rollercart.track.magnetic.desc: Accelerates minecarts based on redstone signal, but cannot climb steep slopes
item.rollercart.track.clear_hint: Cancel first selection by using on a non-track block
rollercart.config.rollercart_client.rota: Recommended to be set to 'false' for users prone to motion sickness. When set to 'false', your player camera orientation will remain level while riding a non-level RollerCart track. Non-level tracks are best experienced in third person when 'rotate_camera' is set to 'false'.
rollercart.config.rollercart_client.trac: Higher values decrease performance and increase visual quality. Determines how many segments tracks will be cut into when rendering, with fewer segments making tracks appear jagged. Does not affect minecart movement along tracks.
When the origin track tie block is this many chunks away from you, its track will stop rendering.
